# Diagnostic codes

Every core code the engine can raise, generated from the registry `spec/diagnostics.toml`
(`spec/diagnostics.md` section 2). `via explain CODE` prints the same text. A step's own codes,
`step.<id>.<name>`, are not listed: their text comes with the step.

Columns: the code, its one severity, the milestone that first raises it, the chapter whose
Diagnostics table holds its row, and the `data` fields its records carry. `data.nearest` is
added where the row gives a nearest name (`spec/diagnostics.md` 1.4); a row that gives the
nearest value, resolution, candidate or instance does not count as one.

324 codes in 21 groups. 274 have no bad and fixed example yet; their explain text is the
chapter's summary and hint.

```text
To fix: Reverse the points, or remove the repeated one.
```

## cli

| Code | Severity | M | Data | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cli.no_world` | error | 1 |  | `via explain` only: the world file given does not exist or is not a file. Exit 2. Every other command reports `doc.file_missing` (`documents.md`). |
| `cli.unknown_code` | error | 1 | `nearest` | `via explain` or `--fail-on` was given an unknown code; the nearest code. Exit 2. |
| `cli.usage` | error | 1 | `nearest` | An unknown flag, a missing argument or a bad value; the argument and the nearest flag. Exit 2. |

### `cli.no_world`

error, milestone 1, `spec/diagnostics.md`.

```text
`via explain` was given a world file that does not exist or is not a file. Exit status 2. Every
other command reports a missing world as doc.file_missing.
Give the path of an existing world file.
Bad:   via explain step.a.b missing.toml
Fixed: via explain step.a.b world.toml
```

### `cli.unknown_code`

error, milestone 1, `spec/diagnostics.md`.

```text
`via explain` or `--fail-on` was given a code that is not registered, and is not a step code of
the last build. Exit status 2. `data.nearest` holds the nearest code.
Write the code as `via explain` lists it.
Bad:   via explain formula.unknwn_name
Fixed: via explain formula.unknown_name
```

### `cli.usage`

error, milestone 1, `spec/diagnostics.md`.

```text
The command line is wrong: an unknown flag, a missing argument, a bad value, or a --fail-on code
that is not a warning. `argument` is the index of the argument at fault, counting from 1 after
the program name. No build is attempted and the exit status is 2.
Write the flag as `via help` lists it; the hint gives the nearest one.
Bad:   via build world.toml --frobnicate
Fixed: via build world.toml
```

## diag

| Code | Severity | M | Data | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `diag.internal` | error | 1 | `message`, `repro` | The engine stopped on a defect of ours; the operation; `data.message` (the panic's text), `data.repro` (the reproduction's digest). Exit 3. |
| `diag.malformed` | error | 1 | `message`, `missing` | A step's diagnostic was malformed (section 6); `data.message`, `data.missing`. |
| `diag.skipped` | info | 1 | `first`, `stage` | A failed node's dependents were not built, or export steps did not run; `count`, `data.first` (the first ten by address), `data.stage`. |

### `diag.internal`

error, milestone 1, `spec/diagnostics.md`, covered by the workspace tests.

```text
The engine stopped on a defect of its own, not of the text: a panic, or a diagnostic whose place
could not be found. The build exits with status 3. `data.message` holds the panic's text and
`data.repro` the digest of the reproduction folder written beside the build directory.
Report it with that folder; no change to the text is needed or expected to help.
Bad:   (none: this is never the text's fault)
Fixed: (none)
```

### `diag.malformed`

error, milestone 1, `spec/diagnostics.md`.

```text
A step sent a diagnostic the engine could not keep: no hint, an empty message, a subject this
world does not have, a code not of the form [a-z][a-z0-9_]*, data that is not a table of plain
values, a position outside the extent, or one code with two severities. `data.message` holds the
step's message and `data.missing` what was wrong.
Change the step so every diagnostic it sends is complete.
Bad:   step.diag.emit(code="too_steep", subject="feature.a", message="too steep")
Fixed: step.diag.emit(code="too_steep", subject="feature.a", message="slope 0.4 over 0.3", hint="lower the slope")
```

### `diag.skipped`

info, milestone 1, `spec/diagnostics.md`.

```text
A node failed, so every node that reads it, directly or through others, was not built. This
record is the one thing said about them: `count` is how many things were skipped and
`data.first` names the first ten. With `data.stage = "export"`, export steps did not run because
the build had an error.
Fix the error on the subject; what was skipped is built again with it.
Bad:   value = "= 2 * hieght"   (an error; everything reading value is skipped)
Fixed: value = "= 2 * height"
```

### `field.base_and_file`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A field with both base and file.
To fix: Keep one.
```

### `field.effect_cut`

warning, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
An effect's mask is above 0.02 on its ring; the effect, the feature and the first post.
To fix: Raise radius, or fade mask to 0 by it.
```

### `field.file_coarse`

warning, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A level step above 0.1 m on a field in m; the step.
To fix: Use 16-bit, or a narrower range.
```

### `field.file_format`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
An unsupported format, depth or palette; an array file whose shape is not 2-D or whose descr is not <f4; a raster with a dimension under 2.
To fix: Save as 8- or 16-bit grey PNG, or an array file.
```

### `field.file_key`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A file key without file, one that does not apply, an unknown channel or filter, or a channel the picture lacks.
To fix: The keys that apply; for luma, name one channel.
```

### `field.file_nonfinite`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A non-finite sample; its row and column.
To fix: Repair the file.
```

### `field.file_offworld`

warning, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A raster extent wholly outside the world's.
To fix: Correct extent.
```

### `field.file_outside`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
file without outside.
To fix: Add outside, the value beyond the raster.
```

### `field.file_profile`

info, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A PNG's gamma, colour profile or tRNS was not applied.
To fix: None needed; levels are read as stored.
```

### `field.file_range`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
range with lo == hi.
To fix: A constant is a base.
```

### `field.file_too_large`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
More samples than the post-count limit; the header's size.
To fix: Crop or downsample the raster.
```

### `field.role_missing`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
No surface field, and something asked for ground; names the first that asked.
To fix: Add a field with role = "surface".
```

### `field.role_range`

warning, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A keep_out value outside 0 to 1, clamped; the field and its first post.
To fix: Wrap the row or base in clamp(..., 0, 1).
```

### `field.role_twice`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A second material field; names both.
To fix: Remove role from one; it is handed over as data.
```

### `field.role_type`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A role on a field of the wrong type.
To fix: The role's type, e.g. type = "weights".
```

### `field.role_unit`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A role on a field with another unit.
To fix: Remove unit, or write the role's.
```

### `field.role_unknown`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A role that is not surface, material or keep_out.
To fix: Nearest role; a library word belongs in tags.
```

### `field.row_key`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
paint on a scalar entry, or value on a weights entry; names the row or effect and the field.
To fix: Use the key of the field's type, or narrow the effect's selector.
```

### `field.row_missing`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A scalar row or entry with no value, or a weights one with no paint; names the row or effect.
To fix: Add the key.
```

### `field.step_base`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A step's document sets base, file, role, type, unit or tags on a field it did not declare.
To fix: Return rows on the field instead.
```

### `field.step_layer`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A step's row on a field of a higher layer.
To fix: Move the step up, or the field down.
```

### `field.type_unknown`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A type not on the list.
To fix: Nearest type; for material: type = "weights", role = "material".
```

### `field.unit_unknown`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A unit not on the list.
To fix: Nearest unit.
```

### `field.unpainted`

warning, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
Posts of the material field with weights summing below 1; the first and the count.
To fix: Add a first row with no mask.
```

### `field.weights_base`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
base or file on a weights field.
To fix: Read the raster as a scalar field and use it as a row's mask.
```

### `field.weights_unit`

error, milestone 1, `spec/fields.md`.

```text
A unit other than ratio on a weights field.
To fix: Remove unit.
```

## formula

| Code | Severity | M | Data | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `formula.arguments` | error | 1 |  | Wrong count, an unknown or repeated named argument, or a positional one after a named one. |
| `formula.cap` | error | 1 |  | `dist` or `sdist` without a cap and without a `radius` to default to. |
| `formula.character` | error | 1 |  | A character outside the language; names it; for upper case, "names are lower case". |
| `formula.empty_selection` | warning | 1 |  | A `kind:` selection is empty at its stratum; says the value used. Once per formula and stratum. |
| `formula.not_finite` | error | 1 |  | A live operation gave a non-finite value; names the operation, operands, post and feature. |
| `formula.operator` | error | 1 |  | An operator of another language, or `=` for `==`; names ours. |
| `formula.outside_field` | error | 1 |  | A field read at a point beyond the extent. |
| `formula.range` | error | 1 |  | A value outside its key's or parameter's range, at a named post or feature. |
| `formula.rate` | error | 1 |  | A sub-expression's rate is above what the key or parameter allows; names it. |
| `formula.seed` | error | 1 |  | A seed that is not a name. |
| `formula.seed_shared` | warning | 1 |  | Two noise calls of one owner use one stream. |
| `formula.selector` | error | 1 |  | A selector names nothing, is of the wrong class, or uses `role:`. |
| `formula.selector_count` | error | 1 |  | A selection holds more things than the function takes, or none where it needs one. |
| `formula.shadow` | error | 1 |  | A `let` or attribute name equals a built-in or keyword, a `let` name equals a field's, or one name is declared twice in one scope. |
| `formula.shape` | error | 1 |  | A function given a feature of a shape it cannot take. |
| `formula.syntax` | error | 1 |  | The text does not parse; names the span and what was expected (section 2's table). |
| `formula.too_deep` | error | 1 |  | Nesting over 64 deep. |
| `formula.too_long` | error | 1 |  | The formula text is over 4096 bytes. |
| `formula.type` | error | 1 |  | A number where yes/no is needed, or the reverse; a selector out of place; a text, array or table attribute read; a formula for a bool or text attribute; a `weights` field read by `f`. |
| `formula.unknown_function` | error | 1 | `nearest` | A call names no function in the table; the alias table below, else the nearest function. |
| `formula.unknown_name` | error | 1 | `name`, `nearest` | A name is not visible here (`data.name`); nearest name, and where it does exist. |
| `formula.unmarked` | error | 1 |  | A formula key holds a string that does not start with `=`, or any string starts with spaces before `=`. |

### `formula.arguments`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
A call has the wrong number of arguments, an unknown or repeated named argument, or a positional
argument after a named one.
Give the arguments the function's entry in the table lists, positional first.
Bad:   value = "= clamp(a, 0)"
Fixed: value = "= clamp(a, 0, 1)"
```

### `formula.cap`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
dist or sdist has no cap, and there is no radius to default to.
Give the cap.
Bad:   value = "= dist('tag:edge')"
Fixed: value = "= dist('tag:edge', 40)"
```

### `formula.character`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
The formula holds a character outside the language. Names are lower case.
Remove the character, or write the name in lower case.
Bad:   value = "= 2 * Height"
Fixed: value = "= 2 * height"
```

### `formula.empty_selection`

warning, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
A kind: selection is empty at its stratum, so the function used its value for nothing. Reported
once per formula and stratum; the message says the value used.
Add a feature of that kind below this layer, or drop the term.
Bad:   value = "= dist('kind:k', 10)"   (no feature of kind k here)
Fixed: value = "= 1"
```

### `formula.not_finite`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
An operation gave an infinity or NaN; the record names the operation, its operands, the post and
the feature. No non-finite value is ever stored.
Guard the operation (a divisor away from 0, a root of a non-negative value).
Bad:   value = "= 1 / a"   (a is 0 at one post)
Fixed: value = "= 1 / max(a, 0.001)"
```

### `formula.operator`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
The formula uses an operator of another language, or `=` where `==` compares.
Use the operator the hint names.
Bad:   value = "= if(a = 1, 2, 3)"
Fixed: value = "= if(a == 1, 2, 3)"
```

### `formula.outside_field`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
A field was read at a point beyond the world's extent.
Read inside the extent, or clamp the point.
Bad:   (a read of a field at a point beyond the extent)
Fixed: (the same read at a point inside it)
```

### `formula.range`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
A value is outside its key's or parameter's range at a named post or feature.
Bound the value, or change the inputs that push it out.
Bad:   radius = "= a - 10"   (a is 4 at one feature)
Fixed: radius = "= max(a - 10, 1)"
```

### `formula.rate`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
A sub-expression varies faster than the key or parameter allows (a value per post where only
one per feature is taken). The record names the sub-expression.
Reduce it to the allowed rate (a mean over the feature, say), or move it to a key that takes it.
Bad:   radius = "= f('height')"   (varies by post; radius takes one value per feature)
Fixed: radius = "= 4"
```

### `formula.seed`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
A noise call's seed is not a name.
Write a name.
Bad:   value = "= fbm(60, 3, seed = 7)"
Fixed: value = "= fbm(60, 3, seed = 'base')"
```

### `formula.seed_shared`

warning, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
Two noise calls of one owner use one stream, so they move together.
Give each call its own seed name.
Bad:   value = "= fbm(60, 3) + fbm(20, 2)"
Fixed: value = "= fbm(60, 3, seed = 'a') + fbm(20, 2, seed = 'b')"
```

### `formula.selector`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
A selector names nothing, names a thing of the wrong class, or uses role:.
Select by tag: or by a name that exists.
Bad:   value = "= dist('role:surface', 10)"
Fixed: value = "= dist('tag:edge', 10)"
```

### `formula.selector_count`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
A selection holds more things than the function takes, or none where it needs one.
Narrow the selector to what the function takes.
Bad:   value = "= sdist('tag:paths', 10)"   (several paths; sdist takes one)
Fixed: value = "= sdist('tag:one_path', 10)"
```

### `formula.shadow`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
A let or attribute name equals a built-in or keyword, a let name equals a field's, or one name is
declared twice in one scope.
Rename one of the two.
Bad:   [let] x = "= 2"
Fixed: [let] x_scale = "= 2"
```

### `formula.shape`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
A function was given a feature of a shape it cannot take (a point where a region is needed).
Select features of the shape the function takes.
Bad:   value = "= inside('tag:points')"
Fixed: value = "= inside('tag:areas')"
```

### `formula.syntax`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
The formula text does not parse; the record points at the span and says what was expected there.
Complete or correct the expression at that span.
Bad:   value = "= 2 * (height + 1"
Fixed: value = "= 2 * (height + 1)"
```

### `formula.too_deep`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
The formula nests over 64 deep, so it is not read further.
Name inner parts in [let].
Bad:   value = "= ((((((... a ...))))))"   (65 levels)
Fixed: [let] inner = "= (a)"   and   value = "= (inner)"
```

### `formula.too_long`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
The formula text is over 4096 bytes.
Split it: name parts in [let] and read them by name.
Bad:   value = "= a + a + a + ... (5000 bytes)"
Fixed: [let] part = "= a + a"   and   value = "= part + part"
```

### `formula.type`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
A value of the wrong type: a number where yes/no is needed or the reverse, a selector out of
place, or an attribute that is not a number read as one.
Compare to get yes/no, or use if() to get a number.
Bad:   value = "= if(a, 1, 0)"   (a is a number)
Fixed: value = "= if(a > 0, 1, 0)"
```

### `formula.unknown_function`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
A call names no function in the table. Some names from other languages have a fixed answer
(clip is clamp, lerp is mix); otherwise `data.nearest` holds the nearest function.
Call a function of the table, or the one the hint names.
Bad:   value = "= clip(a, 0, 1)"
Fixed: value = "= clamp(a, 0, 1)"
```

### `formula.unknown_name`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
A formula read a name that is not a field, a let name or an attribute of its owner.
`data.nearest` holds the nearest visible name, and `related` points at its declaration.
Write the name as declared, or declare it in [let].
Bad:   value = "= 2 * hieght"
Fixed: value = "= 2 * height"
```

### `formula.unmarked`

error, milestone 1, `spec/formulas.md`.

```text
A key that takes a formula holds a string that does not start with `=`, or has spaces before it.
Only a string starting with `=` is read as a formula.
Start the string with `=`.
Bad:   value = " = 2 * height"
Fixed: value = "= 2 * height"
```

| `num.extent_not_multiple` | error | 1 |  | The extent's width or height is not a whole multiple of `resolution`. The hint keeps `x0`, `y0` and gives `x1`, `y1` rounded down and up, and the nearest resolutions that divide both widths. |
| `num.not_finite` | error | 1 |  | A number in text is `inf` or `nan`. |
| `num.not_finite_result` | error | 1 |  | A step or a stored feature value would store an infinite or NaN value. Names the step or feature and the row or position. A formula's is `formula.not_finite`. |
| `num.out_of_range` | error | 1 |  | A number in text out of range: a length beyond plus or minus `2^31 - 1` mm, a facing beyond 64 bits, a double whose nearest value is infinite. Computed positions out of range are `geom.range`. |
| `num.overflow` | error | 1 |  | A checked integer operation overflowed. Names the subject and the position. |
| `num.resolution` | error | 1 |  | `resolution` is below 1 mm. |
| `num.seed_range` | error | 1 |  | The world `seed` is negative. |
| `num.seed_type` | error | 1 |  | A seed of the wrong form: a world seed not an integer; a scatter seed not a name, or a name that breaks the id grammar. The hint suggests a name, or the lower-cased form. |
| `num.too_many_posts` | error | 1 |  | `nx * ny` exceeds the post limit. Names `nx`, `ny` and the limit. |
| `num.too_precise` | error | 1 |  | A length is not a whole number of millimetres, or a facing not a whole number of millidegrees. The hint names the two nearest values that are. |

### `num.empty_reduction`

error, milestone 1, `spec/numbers.md`.

```text
A mean, minimum or maximum over a feature with no samples. Names the feature.
```

### `num.extent_empty`

error, milestone 1, `spec/numbers.md`.

```text
The extent has x1 <= x0 or y1 <= y0, so the world has no area.
Write the corners as [x0, y0, x1, y1] with x1 > x0 and y1 > y0.
Bad:   extent = [100, 0, 0, 100]
Fixed: extent = [0, 0, 100, 100]
```

### `num.extent_not_multiple`

error, milestone 1, `spec/numbers.md`.

```text
The extent's width or height is not a whole multiple of the resolution. The hint keeps x0 and y0
and gives x1 and y1 rounded down and up, and the nearest resolutions that divide both widths.
Write one of them.
Bad:   extent = [0, 0, 100.25, 100]   with resolution = 0.5
Fixed: extent = [0, 0, 100.5, 100]
```

### `num.not_finite`

error, milestone 1, `spec/numbers.md`.

```text
A number in the text is inf or nan, which no key takes.
Write a finite number.
Bad:   value = nan
Fixed: value = 0
```

### `num.not_finite_result`

error, milestone 1, `spec/numbers.md`.

```text
A step or a stored feature value would store an infinite or NaN value. Names the step or feature and the row or position. A formula's is formula.not_finite.
```

### `num.out_of_range`

error, milestone 1, `spec/numbers.md`.

```text
A number is out of range: a length beyond plus or minus 2^31 - 1 mm, a facing beyond 64 bits, a
double too large to hold.
Write a number in range.
Bad:   width = 3000000
Fixed: width = 3000
```

### `num.overflow`

error, milestone 1, `spec/numbers.md`.

```text
A checked integer operation overflowed. Names the subject and the position.
```

### `num.resolution`

error, milestone 1, `spec/numbers.md`.

```text
The resolution is below 1 mm.
Write a post spacing of at least 0.001.
Bad:   resolution = 0.0001
Fixed: resolution = 0.5
```

### `num.seed_range`

error, milestone 1, `spec/numbers.md`.

```text
The world seed is negative.
Write a seed of 0 or more.
Bad:   seed = -1
Fixed: seed = 1
```

### `num.seed_type`

error, milestone 1, `spec/numbers.md`.

```text
A seed has the wrong form: a world seed that is not an integer, or a scatter seed that is not a
name or breaks the id grammar.
Write the form the hint suggests.
Bad:   seed = "Base"   (on a scatter)
Fixed: seed = "base"
```

### `num.too_many_posts`

error, milestone 1, `spec/numbers.md`.

```text
The grid would hold more posts than the limit; the record names nx, ny and the limit.
Use a coarser resolution or a smaller extent.
Bad:   extent = [0, 0, 100000, 100000]   with resolution = 0.5
Fixed: extent = [0, 0, 100000, 100000]   with resolution = 8
```

### `num.too_precise`

error, milestone 1, `spec/numbers.md`.

```text
A length is not a whole number of millimetres, or a facing not a whole number of millidegrees.
The hint gives the two nearest values that are.
Write one of them.
Bad:   width = 1.0005
Fixed: width = 1.001
```

## pack

| Code | Severity | M | Data | Summary |

| `pack.accept_refused` | error | 2 |  | `via pack accept` found errors; nothing written. |
| `pack.bad_axes` | error | 1 |  | `front` or `up` is not one of the six signed axes, or both name one axis. |
| `pack.bad_facts` | error | 2 |  | The facts file is not readable, or not in 4.1's form. |
| `pack.bad_model` | error | 2 |  | A model is not readable glTF 2.0, holds a non-finite number or a bad index count, or uses an extension v0 does not read. |
| `pack.material_repeat` | error | 1 |  | A material has `file` without `repeat`, or `repeat` without `file`. |
| `pack.missing_file` | error | 1 | `nearest` | `root`, a file the pack names, or a URI a model references, does not exist. M1 checks `root` and a material's `file`; M2 adds models, `detail` copies and their URIs. |
| `pack.not_found` | error | 1 | `nearest` | The `pack` string names no file; the roots searched, by place. |
| `pack.outside_root` | error | 2 |  | A file reached outside `root`: an absolute URI, a `..` out of it, a scheme other than `data:`, a symbolic link. |
| `pack.range` | error | 1 |  | A pack number out of range: `size` or `repeat` not above 0, `triangles`, `max_relief` below 0, a `colour` part outside 0 to 1. |
| `pack.shadowed` | info | 1 |  | A pack name found in several roots. |
| `pack.stale_facts` | info | 2 |  | The facts file holds ids the pack no longer has. |
| `pack.unaccepted` | info | 2 |  | The pack has model assets and no facts file; revisions cannot be reported. |
| `pack.unknown_material` | error | 1 | `nearest` | A `paint` names a material the pack lacks. |
| `pack.unknown_taxon` | error | 1 | `nearest` | An asset's `taxon`, a selection or a `--taxon` filter names an undeclared taxon. |

### `pack.accept_refused`

error, milestone 2, `spec/assets.md`.

```text
via pack accept found errors; nothing written.
To fix: Fix the listed errors, then accept again.
```

### `pack.bad_axes`

error, milestone 1, `spec/assets.md`.

```text
front or up is not one of the six signed axes, or both name one axis.
To fix: A pair on two axes, for example front = "-y", up = "+z".
```

### `pack.bad_facts`

error, milestone 2, `spec/assets.md`.

```text
The facts file is not readable, or not in 4.1's form.
To fix: Delete it and run via pack accept PACK.
```

### `pack.bad_model`

error, milestone 2, `spec/assets.md`.

```text
A model is not readable glTF 2.0, holds a non-finite number or a bad index count, or uses an extension v0 does not read.
To fix: Re-export without the named extension, or fix the pointed part.
```

### `pack.material_repeat`

error, milestone 1, `spec/assets.md`.

```text
A material has file without repeat, or repeat without file.
To fix: Write both, or neither.
```

### `pack.missing_file`

error, milestone 1, `spec/assets.md`.

```text
root, a file the pack names, or a URI a model references, does not exist. M1 checks root and a material's file; M2 adds models, detail copies and their URIs.
To fix: The nearest file name in that folder.
```

### `pack.not_found`

error, milestone 1, `spec/assets.md`.

```text
The pack string names no file; the roots searched, by place.
To fix: The nearest pack name, or write a path.
```

### `pack.outside_root`

error, milestone 2, `spec/assets.md`.

```text
A file reached outside root: an absolute URI, a .. out of it, a scheme other than data:, a symbolic link.
To fix: Move the file under root, or move root.
```

### `pack.range`

error, milestone 1, `spec/assets.md`.

```text
A pack number out of range: size or repeat not above 0, triangles, max_relief below 0, a colour part outside 0 to 1.
To fix: The allowed range.
```

### `pack.shadowed`

info, milestone 1, `spec/assets.md`.

```text
A pack name found in several roots.
To fix: The one used; write a path to choose another.
```

### `pack.stale_facts`

info, milestone 2, `spec/assets.md`.

```text
The facts file holds ids the pack no longer has.
To fix: Run via pack accept PACK to drop them.
```

### `pack.unaccepted`

info, milestone 2, `spec/assets.md`.

```text
The pack has model assets and no facts file; revisions cannot be reported.
To fix: Run via pack accept PACK.
```

### `pack.unknown_material`

error, milestone 1, `spec/assets.md`.

```text
A paint names a material the pack lacks.
To fix: The nearest material, or add [material.<name>].
```

### `pack.unknown_taxon`

error, milestone 1, `spec/assets.md`.

```text
An asset's taxon, a selection or a --taxon filter names an undeclared taxon.
To fix: The nearest declared path, or declare [taxon."<path>"].
```

### `place.asset_or_set`

error, milestone 1, `spec/rules.md`.

```text
A placement writes both asset and set, or neither.
To fix: Keep one of asset, set.
```

### `place.crowded`

warning, milestone 1, `spec/rules.md`.

```text
Two produced instances overlap (8.1), or one overlaps a thing in a higher layer; names both.
To fix: Change one producer's on or span, or add a clear or pin in the higher layer with by naming the lower producer.
```

### `place.gave_way`

info, milestone 1, `spec/rules.md`.

```text
A producer's candidates dropped by overlap and by relief, as counts, with their box.
To fix: Widen the space or change the hand instances it gives way to; nothing if intended.
```

### `place.keep_out`

warning, milestone 1, `spec/rules.md`.

```text
An instance stands where keep_out is above 0; names the field and the position.
To fix: Move it, or change the kind whose effect writes keep_out there.
```

### `place.margin_alone`

error, milestone 1, `spec/rules.md`.

```text
margin without ground.
To fix: Add ground = "<kind>", or remove margin.
```

### `place.no_footprint`

error, milestone 1, `spec/rules.md`.

```text
ground on an asset with no footprint.
To fix: Declare the asset's footprint, or remove ground.
```

### `place.no_position`

error, milestone 1, `spec/rules.md`.

```text
An instance or pin has neither at nor on; a run has no on.
To fix: Write at or on.
```

### `place.on_form`

error, milestone 1, `spec/rules.md`.

```text
span in an instance's on, or t in a run's on. (t or offset on a thing with no length is geom.no_length.)
To fix: Write t on an instance, span on a run.
```

### `place.outside`

error, milestone 1, `spec/rules.md`.

```text
A hand instance or set item whose origin is outside the extent; not placed (8.4).
To fix: Move it inside the extent, or widen the extent.
```

### `place.overlap`

error, milestone 1, `spec/rules.md`.

```text
Two hand instances' footprints overlap; names both.
To fix: Move one; the overlap's size is given.
```

### `place.range`

error, milestone 1, `spec/rules.md`.

```text
On an instance, run or set item: scale not above 0, tint below 0, margin below 0, or a [lo, hi] pair (only a scatter draws).
To fix: The key and its allowed range.
```

### `place.relief`

warning, milestone 1, `spec/rules.md`.

```text
Relief under an instance exceeds its asset's max_relief; gives both numbers and the position.
To fix: Move it, give it ground with a kind that levels, or choose an asset with a larger max_relief.
```

| `protocol.output_table` | error | 1 |  | A returned document holds a table or key a step may not return, or a lint or export returned one. |
| `protocol.output_twice` | error | 1 |  | A worker returned a document and wrote `document.toml`. |
| `protocol.raised` | error | 1 | `exception` | The step raised an exception it did not catch; `data.exception`. |
| `protocol.slow_exit` | info | 1 |  | A worker had to be killed after `shutdown`. |
| `protocol.start` | error | 1 | `kind` | The process could not be started; `data.kind` (6.2). |
| `protocol.unknown_library` | error | 1 | `nearest` | A `lib:` element names a library not in `include`; the nearest name. |
| `protocol.untrusted` | error | 1 |  | A generate step is not trusted and has no committed result; the hint is `via trust`. |

| `protocol.untrusted_skipped` | warning | 1 |  | An untrusted lint or export step was skipped. |

| `protocol.version` | error | 1 | `engine`, `worker` | The worker speaks another protocol version; both versions, `data.engine` and `data.worker`. |
| `protocol.when_unserved` | error | 1 | `when` | The worker's `capabilities.when` lacks the step's `when`, `data.when`. |

| `surface.apart` | error | 3 |  | Two paired mounts lie at different plan points; gives both. |

| `surface.empty_region` | error | 1 |  | A region given to `relief` has zero area. |
| `surface.facing` | error | 5 |  | Two paired mounts do not face opposite ways; both bearings. |
| `surface.fold` | error | 3 |  | Its strip overlaps itself; position and the largest bound that holds. |
| `surface.gap` | error | 3 |  | The two sides differ in height; both heights, the gap in millimetres, and what sets each (3.4). Hint: "make the two sides equal: change <a> or <b>, or add an effect of <owner> that sets the ground to <z>". |
| `surface.ground_off_terrain` | error | 3 |  | `ground` on an instance that stands on a kind surface. |
| `surface.host_missing` | error | 1 |  | What it is placed `on`, or the owner of the mount it is placed on, was not placed (4.1). |
| `surface.meets_self` | error | 3 |  | `meets` names the mount itself. |
| `surface.meets_twice` | error | 3 |  | The mount is in two `meets` pairs; names both others. |
| `surface.mount_face` | error | 3 |  | A face word on a kind mount. Hint: a number, 0 along travel, 180 against. |
| `surface.name_clash` | error | 3 |  | A surface and a mount share a name. |
| `surface.off_bound` | warning | 3 |  | Part of its footprint lies outside its surface's bound; the share. |
| `surface.outside` | error | 3 |  | Its plan point lies inside the extent but outside the bound of the kind surface it stands on. An origin outside the extent is `place.outside` (`rules.md` 8.4), never this code. |
| `surface.owner_shape` | error | 3 |  | A surface on a point kind, a path owner without `bound`, or a region owner with one. |
| `surface.through` | warning | 3 |  | Its height reaches through another surface above its origin; names it. |
| `surface.too_early` | error | 2 |  | `meetings()` called at `generate`. |
| `surface.two_terrains` | error | 1 |  | Two surface fields at the top level. Hint: make one a kind's surface. |
| `surface.unknown_mount` | error | 3 |  | `meets` names a mount the kind lacks; lists the kind's mounts. |
| `surface.unknown_surface` | error | 3 |  | `surface` names a surface the kind lacks; lists the kind's surfaces. |
| `surface.unmet` | warning | 5 |  | A mount with a connector is answered by nothing (R18: a stub). Hint: "end a path whose kind has connector <c> here: `ends_at = \"<place>\"`". |
| `surface.which` | error | 3 |  | `on` a thing, or a path end on a kind, with two or more surfaces; lists them. Hint: place it `on` a mount. |
